title: Agent J webhook (P366, AGENTJ-HOOKS-SPEC §8.1)
description: One hosted webhook: https://hook.agentj.app/<hb>/<id>[/<token>]. `agentj hook create --file <this>` accepts every field except id, created, approved and state (the host sets those); command-line flags override the file. Secrets are never part of a definition.

life.description: once: void after the first accepted delivery (≤ 7 d) · ttl: until it expires (≤ 30 d) · resident: until revoked, needs the owner's approval on the paired phone

e2e.description: end-to-end encrypted delivery: the sender seals the body to `seal.pub` (RFC 9180 HPKE base, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, ChaCha20-Poly1305; info "agentj-hook-seal-v1\n" + id; body = enc ‖ ciphertext; header X-AgentJ-Seal: v1; kid=<kid>) and our relay forwards ciphertext only. Needs auth.kind hmac (signed over the plaintext). false (default) = the request crosses our relay in the clear, in memory only

pub.description: X25519 public key, b64url (not a secret)

note.description: one line for the main Agent: what this hook is for
